intro: A social media manager resume that shows audiences grown, campaigns run and the business those channels brought in.
tips: Show growth and engagement with numbers, per channel.
Tie social results to sales, sign-ups or leads.
Name the channels, tools and the budget you managed.

basics.name: Zoe Martinez
basics.label: Social Media Manager
basics.summary: Social media manager with six years growing brands on Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn. I mix creative ideas with careful measurement, and I know which posts sell.

work.name: Coastline Swim
highlights: Grew Instagram from 80,000 to 450,000 followers and TikTok from zero to 300,000.
Social now drives 25% of online sales, up from 8%.
Manage a $600,000 yearly paid social budget and 30 creator partnerships.

work.name: Brightside Agency
highlights: Ran content calendars for nine restaurant and hotel clients.
Launched a hotel's TikTok; one series reached 4 million views and filled a slow season.
